answer: Neither claim is asserted. Salt Roads has creator Mira. Tomas is explicitly translator of the Harbor edition, which is an edition of Salt Roads; this indirectly associates Tomas with the work but does not assert work authorship. The Inland edition is also an edition of Salt Roads, with no translator statement in this catalog. Shared editionOf does not transfer the Harbor translator to Inland. Missing statements do not prove global absence.
